content: Loi le dagerawe weya Nowa
Loi i mwaewo weya Nowa na le ŋgaŋga na iŋa, “Hu ghambɨ na lemi ŋgaŋga na lenji ŋgaŋgaova na thɨ riyevanjara yambaneke.
Thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye, maa thɨ yoyo na borogi e njighɨko, na bigibigike wolaghɨye thɨ lili e gharenji e thelau vwatae ne thɨ mararuŋga. Kaero ya bigirawe e nɨmami ghare.
Bigibigike wolaghɨye thɨ nyivɨnyivɨ na e yawayawalinji ya vatomwe weŋga ghami, na tembe ŋgoreiyeva umbwaumbwa na nana ndamwanji vwivwivu, kaero ya vatomwevao weŋga na ghami.
“Ko iyemaeŋge ne hu ndeghana thetheghan mbunɨmaniye thoŋgo madɨbae mbe ina e tɨneko kaiwae madibe i giya yawalɨ.

Kaiwae madibe iye i vakatha bigi regha e yawayawaliye. Iya kaiwae thoŋgo thela i vakowana lolo yawaliye na i mare, vuyowae loloko iyako wone i mare, na tembe ŋgoreiyeva thetheghan i vakowana lolo yawaliye na i mare, thetheghanɨko iyako wone i mare.

content.text: Kaiwae va ya vakatha lolo mbe
iya kaiwae thoŋgo lolo i unɨgha lolo regha

content: Ko Nowa ghen na len ŋgaŋga, hu ghambɨraka mbala orumburumbumi thɨ yala na thɨ riyevanjara yambaneke.”
Loi i dage weŋgiya Nowa na le ŋgaŋga iŋa,
“E mbaŋake iyake ya vakatha lo dagerawe e ghemi na weŋgiya orumburumbu mbaŋa muyaiko,
na tembe ŋgoreiyeva bigibigike wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji, maake wolaghɨye na thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye — mbema bigibigike wolaghɨye vara va hu rakaraŋgi e waŋgana weinaŋgi.
E utuutuŋgike thiyake ya vakatha lo dagerawe e ghemi: Ya dagerawe maa tene mbaŋa reghava ya vakatha yambaneke i thotho na i vakowana yawal; maa tene mbaŋa reghava thotho i vakowana yambaneke.”
Loi iŋa, “Dageraweke iya ma vakatha e ghandalughawoghawoke na thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji, tha na tha kaiwanji ghanono iyake,
ya worawa bwawo e ŋgalɨlɨko na iyake i tabo na nono lo dageraweke ghino na yambaneke ghandalughawoghawo.
Mbaŋa ya vakatha uye ghaŋgalɨlɨ na thɨ yomara e buruburuko na bwawo i thowo,
ne i vanuwovɨrɨŋgo lo dageraweko weiŋgu ghemi na thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji na tomethi wabwi e ghandalughawoghawoke. Maa tene mbaŋa reghava mbwa thɨ thotho na thɨ vakowana yawal.

Nevole the mbaŋa ya thuwe bwawoko i thowo e ŋgalɨlɨko, ne ya renuwaŋakikiya dageraweko iya memeghabananiyeko ghino na bigibigike wolaghɨye e yawayawalinji na tomethi wabwi e yambaneke e ghandalughawoghawo.”
Loi i dage weya Nowa iŋa, “Dageraweke iya ma vakathake ghino na yawal e yambane ghandalughawoghawo iya ghanono iyake.”
Nowa na le ŋgaŋga
Nowa na le ŋgaŋga va i raŋgi weiyaŋgi e waŋgako tɨne thiyake: Sem, Ham na Jepet. (Ham nariya Keinan.)
Nowa le ŋgaŋgake thenjighetoke thiyake iya orumburumbunji vara gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye e yambaneke.
Nowa, iye va rakakaiwo e uma, va i kabukai vara waen.
Mbaŋa i muna waen, i wovaghawa umbaliye, i bigiyatho ghakwama na i ghena bukabuka ele yoŋathowathowa tɨne.
Mbaŋa Ham, Keinan ramae, i thuwe ramae i ghena bukabuka, i njogha eto na ve utugiya weŋgiya oghaghaema thenjighewoma.

Amba Sem na Jepet thɨ liya kwama ghayaboyabo, thɨ lirawe e vwatanji, thɨ loŋgaloŋgaŋa ghereinji na thɨ ru, ko amba thɨ liyabo ramanji. Ghamwanji va i njogha e ghereinji na mbala thava thɨ thuwe i ghenebukako.
Mbaŋa Nowa i thuweiru na le renuwaŋa i rumwaru, i loŋwevaidiya budakai nariye me wo vala uyewe le vakathawe,
iŋa,

content.text: Iye nevole Sem na Jepet lenji rakakaiwobwagaŋgi.”

content: Mbowo i dageva,

content.text: “Tarawa i voro weya Giya Loi, iye Sem le Loi!
Loi nevole i vakatha Jepet na le ghamba mbaro i laghɨye!
Orumburumbuye nevole thɨ yaku na regha weinji Sem le wabwi!
Keinan iye nevole Jepet le rakakaiwobwagaŋgi.”

content: Thothoko e ghereiye Nowa mbowo i yakuva theghathegha hweseriyeto na hwelima (350).
Gha theghathegha vama i wo hweseriyesiwo na hwelima (950) amba i mare.
